sentences.text: 3. As per prosecution case, this petitioner established physical relation with minor daughter of the informant on pretext of marriage and thereafter, refused to marry.

Victim in her statement,
recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C., has supported the prosecution case.
Trial Court has assessed the age of victim to be 17 years.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.37335 of 2025(6) dt.02-12-2025 4.
In view of the gravity of the offence and statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is refused.
